environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via custom runtime. Function URL enabled with AuthType=NONE (public). IAM execution role has lambda:InvokeFunction and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue. No deserialization filters configured. Credential validation is present but the function URL bypasses API Gateway, and a static long-lived service account token (rotated manually every 90 days) is accepted alongside the rotating tokens for backward compatibility with internal monitoring. The commons-collections 3.2.1 library is on the classpath for legacy event transformation utilities.
